content.text: {"rows":[{"source_id":"fr42c-010-0080","target":"Леди Элен, стоя на юте, в последний раз воскликнула:"},{"source_id":"fr42c-010-0081","target":"— Друзья мои, да поможет вам Бог!"},{"source_id":"fr42c-010-0082","target":"— И он нам поможет, сударыня, — ответил Жак Паганель, — ибо, прошу вас поверить, мы и сами себе поможем!"},{"source_id":"fr42c-010-0083","target":"— Вперёд! — крикнул Джон Манглс своему механику."},{"source_id":"fr42c-010-0084","target":"— В путь! — ответил лорд Гленарван."},{"source_id":"fr42c-010-0085","target":"И в тот самый миг, когда путешественники, отпустив поводья своим лошадям, поехали по дороге вдоль берега, «Дункан», движимый винтом, на всех парах снова взял курс на океан."},{"source_id":"fr42c-note-019","target":"Известный лондонский боксёр."}],"review":[{"source_id":"fr42c-010-0080","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Lady Helena on the dunette, 'one last time' exclaimed: faithful; established name Элен and 'на юте' correct."},{"source_id":"fr42c-010-0081","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Opening quotation continues across paragraphs; Russian dash dialogue is correct and wording is faithful."},{"source_id":"fr42c-010-0082","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Paganel's reply preserves 'he will help us' and 'we shall help ourselves'; register suits; no omissions."},{"source_id":"fr42c-010-0083","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Mangles shouts 'Forward!' to his engineer; name matches established form."},{"source_id":"fr42c-010-0084","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Glenarvan answers 'En route!'; closing quotation correctly converted to dialogue dash; faithful."},{"source_id":"fr42c-010-0085","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Travellers loosen reins, follow the shore road; Duncan italic preserved; full steam toward the Ocean; complete and accurate."},{"source_id":"fr42c-note-019","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Note 'Famous boxer of London' accurately rendered; note role preserved."}]}
